sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Ian Chilog is a radio producer.
sentences.zh: 伊恩·奇洛格是一位广播制作人。

sentences.en: You might recognize his name from the end credits of the NPR quiz show,
sentences.zh: 你可能在NPR问答节目《等等，等等，别告诉我》的片尾制作名单中，

sentences.en: Wait, Wait, Don't Tell Me,
sentences.zh: 或者作为现已停播的播客《如何做任何事》的联合主持人，

sentences.en: or as the co-host of the now defunct podcast, How to Do Everything,
sentences.zh: 听到过他的名字，

sentences.en: which I just loved.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢那个节目。

sentences.en: It's such a good show.
sentences.zh: 那真是一个好节目。

sentences.en: He has a new podcast out right now, launching this week,
sentences.zh: 他现在有一个新播客，本周刚刚上线，

sentences.en: and it's delightfully weird.
sentences.zh: 而且它怪得很有趣。

sentences.en: Well, the show is called Everything is Alive,
sentences.zh: 嗯，这个节目叫《万物皆有生命》，

sentences.en: and it's an interview show in which all the subjects are inanimate objects.
sentences.zh: 这是一个访谈节目，所有的受访对象都是无生命物体。

sentences.en: So I talk to things.
sentences.zh: 所以我是在和各种东西对话。

sentences.en: So what made you want to do a show like this?
sentences.zh: 那么是什么让你想做这样一个节目呢？

sentences.en: Well, a couple things.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有几个原因。

sentences.en: One, I think it's just like I would just sort of think this way.
sentences.zh: 第一，我觉得这就像是我平时思考问题的方式。

sentences.en: Like I'd get up from a chair and think about what a terrible job the chair had
sentences.zh: 比如我从椅子上站起来，会想到这把椅子做的工作有多糟糕，

sentences.en: and how the chair must feel about being sat on all the time.
sentences.zh: 以及它一直被人坐着会有什么感受。

sentences.en: And then also, like, I think producing for so long,
sentences.zh: 还有，我觉得做了这么久的制作人，

sentences.en: you're always trying to get to, like, the primary source, you know?
sentences.zh: 你总是试图找到原始来源，你懂吗？

sentences.en: And, like, you're always looking for experts.
sentences.zh: 而且你总是在寻找专家。

sentences.en: I thought it would be really fun if, like, you know,
sentences.zh: 我想如果，你知道，

sentences.en: you're putting together a piece about rainbows or whatever,
sentences.zh: 你在制作一个关于彩虹之类的节目，

sentences.en: and, like, rather than talk to the physicist who understands rainbows,
sentences.zh: 与其去采访了解彩虹的物理学家，

sentences.en: if you could actually talk to the rainbow.
sentences.zh: 如果你能直接采访彩虹本人，那会非常有趣。

sentences.en: So that's kind of the idea.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是大概的想法。

sentences.en: I know that listeners to 99% Invisible are fully capable of accepting
sentences.zh: 我知道《99%隐形》的听众完全能够接受，

sentences.en: that even the most mundane objects are infused with great meaning
sentences.zh: 即使是最平凡的物体也蕴含着巨大的意义，

sentences.en: and can say something about us as humans.
sentences.zh: 并且能反映我们作为人类的一些特质。

sentences.en: But you may not be prepared for that object to actually talk.
sentences.zh: 但你可能还没准备好让那个物体真的开口说话。

sentences.en: So I asked Ian for a primer on how to listen to Everything is Alive.
sentences.zh: 所以我请伊恩为我们提供了一份如何收听《万物皆有生命》的入门指南。

sentences.en: You know, if I was talking to a candle, say, like a bedroom candle,
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果我是在和一支蜡烛对话，比如卧室里的蜡烛，

sentences.en: like, it's not every candle.
sentences.zh: 它并不代表所有的蜡烛。

sentences.en: It's not speaking for every candle.
sentences.zh: 它不是在为所有蜡烛代言。

sentences.en: It is one candle that has sat on one nightstand forever
sentences.zh: 它是一支在床头柜上待了很久的蜡烛，

sentences.en: and, like, been blown out by one person forever
sentences.zh: 被同一个人吹灭了无数次，

sentences.en: and has a relationship with that person.
sentences.zh: 并与那个人有着某种关系。

sentences.en: But they're kind of aware of their object communities.
sentences.zh: 但它们对自己的物体群体是有所认知的。

sentences.en: Like, it knows more about candles than we do.
sentences.zh: 比如，它比我们更了解蜡烛。

sentences.en: It also has, like, very distinct lifetime of experiences.
sentences.zh: 它也有着非常独特的生命经历。

sentences.en: But the things that it says are all factual.
sentences.zh: 但它所说的一切都是事实。

sentences.en: I think I was surprised by that when I first heard the episodes that I've—
sentences.zh: 我想当我第一次听到这些片段时，我感到很惊讶——

sentences.en: the samples that I've heard.
sentences.zh: 我听到的那些样本。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They know things.
sentences.zh: 它们知道一些事情。

sentences.en: They know real things about their world.
sentences.zh: 它们知道关于它们世界的真实情况。

sentences.en: For the most part, they're the inanimate object version
sentences.zh: 在很大程度上，它们就像是无生命物体版的，

sentences.en: of the person at the party who, like, always has an anecdote for everything.
sentences.zh: 那种在派对上对什么事都能讲出一段轶闻的人。

sentences.en: They're very aware of history and of stories of what they are.
sentences.zh: 它们非常了解自己的历史和故事。

sentences.en: So even though the situation is quite absurd on the face,
sentences.zh: 所以尽管表面上看起来很荒谬，

sentences.en: when you hear a fact, it's a true fact.
sentences.zh: 但当你听到一个事实时，那确实是真的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There is so much about the kind of personal life of the object
sentences.zh: 关于物体个人生活的部分，

sentences.en: that, you know, you know isn't exactly real.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你心里清楚那并不完全真实。

sentences.en: But when I'm telling a story about something real, I don't cite it.
sentences.zh: 但当我在讲述一件真实的事情时，我不会引用出处。

sentences.en: You know, I don't tell you, like, where I heard it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不会告诉你我是从哪里听来的。

sentences.en: And so we're just letting the objects behave in the same way.
sentences.zh: 所以我们只是让这些物体以同样的方式表现。

sentences.en: And so there's probably, you know, there's going to be some mystery.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这其中可能会带有一些神秘感。

sentences.en: And hopefully people will Google and figure out if things are real or not.
sentences.zh: 希望人们会去谷歌搜索，弄清楚哪些是真的，哪些不是。

sentences.en: But, yeah.

sentences.en: We were all purchased together.
sentences.zh: 我们是一起被买走的。

sentences.zh: 事实上，我们的下一个住处是一个保龄球馆，那是为一个12岁孩子的生日派对准备的。

sentences.en: I was not drunk.
sentences.zh: 我没被喝掉。

sentences.zh: 我被留到了最后，带回家放进冰箱，然后被遗忘了，

sentences.zh: 几个月的时间，被塞在冰箱的最里面。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: You were slushy inside?
sentences.zh: 你里面变成冰沙了吗？

sentences.zh: 我里面变成了冰沙。

sentences.en: out for a road trip.

sentences.en: I got to sit in the front seat cup holder, you know?

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.en: When you think about being consumed by a human, do you think about the human that you want
sentences.zh: 但我喜欢想象，如果你被立刻喝掉，那与其说是一个痛苦的过程，

sentences.en: to be in?

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.

sentences.en: The can is cracked open.
sentences.zh: 你成为了他们故事的一部分。

sentences.en: All of this internal fizzing that I have going on finally has somewhere to go.

sentences.en: Just sort of drowned out from your external can.
